scope: Independent read-only source review and21 authored focused HTTP boundary tests; no provider/network/listening sockets/Docker/lifespan/training/remote action. No source edits.

source_findings.blocking_bypass: None found in scoped CORS-origin or UI-bind changes. Full authority regex refuses IPvFuture and bracket-prefix/suffix parser pitfalls; controls/backslash/percent/userinfo/path/query/fragment/wildcard and invalid ports fail closed. Defaultallow_origins=[] limits HTTP CORS grants; direct UI main binds127.0.0.1 without operator override.
source_findings.low_risk_config_note: DNS authority regex admits invalid interior DNS-label forms (e.g. consecutive dots or label-leading hyphen). Exact CORS string matching makes these fail closed rather than expanding an allowed origin; consider stricter labels only if required for config validation.
source_findings.scope_precision: HTTP CORS controls browser access to responses/preflight grants, not general mutation authorization/CSRF or WebSocket Origin enforcement. Existing world-model /ws behavior is unchanged.
source_findings.test_route_precision: AIGA tests use/evolve while actual route is/evolve/{gens}; CORS preflight is independent of route existence, so those tests alone do not prove route preservation.

test_findings.location: tests/test_legacy_http_security.py load_service plus direct UI import in final test
test_findings.issue: When module absent initially, monkeypatch.delitem(...raising=False) has no original slot to restore. Import then leaves cached test-built module after undo.
test_findings.repair_suggestion: Before deleting/importing, register slot with monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules,name,None); then monkeypatch.delitem(sys.modules,name). Undo then restores prior entry or removes previously absent one. Preserve parent-module attribute restoration. Use equivalent lifecycle cleanup for UI import.

qualification: Review/test evidence only; not release, live browser, provider, training or deployed authorization qualification.
